name: folder-branches
description: Two side panes. Git: each folder directly inside the session's folder with the git branch checked out in it, or "no git"; /git opens it. Workers: the project's chats, who is working on what, which step, how long, and whose turn it is; /workers opens it. A chat in the list also takes what the person answered for it on the worker board and types it in as their own words. A worker that has grown large (list.json "compactAbove", 250000 tokens unless set, 0 for never) is compacted when the turn in which it reported its task ends.
